source.doc_type: Audited consolidated and separate financial statements FY2025 (Thai)

notes: Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Thousand Baht. The SCI (p.10) has consolidated and separate columns; the separate columns are used (owner decision 2026-11-10: separate statements for every insurer; the pilot used the consolidated columns). The insurance lines and net investment income are the same in both; other operating expenses, other income, tax and net profit differ slightly. The insurance notes are common to both. The SCI prints the tax expense as a positive figure; it is turned negative. Note 25.1 (columns GMM 7.1 / PAA 7.2 / VFA 7.3 / total) prints expenses as positive figures; they are turned negative. 2568 revenue p.122, expenses p.123; 2567 revenue and expenses p.124 (reinsurance p.125). CSM roll-forward = GMM (7.1.1: 2568 p.69 with closing p.70, 2567 p.70-71) + VFA (7.3.1: 2568 p.88, 2567 p.89), CSM columns; new business = GMM p.72 + VFA p.90 totals (both years on each page). Each summed item records the GMM page; the heading names the VFA page. Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). VFA accretion is '-'. RA release uses 25.1 (311,545 / (77,616)). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses.
